content.text: Call lookup_probe_code with label alpha to obtain its synthetic code. After the tool returns, reply only with the code. The code is not in this request; use the tool.

tools.description: Return the synthetic code for the label alpha from the local probe's fixed lookup. The code is not included in the user request. Use this tool when asked to look up that code; pass label alpha. The host returns a single synthetic code without contacting any external system.
tools.name: lookup_probe_code
